title: Introduce Service struct wrapping rust_panic_service free functions
description: Brownfield Rust refactor: add a Service unit struct whose methods delegate to the existing package-level functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a Service struct to src/lib.rs. All 5 existing tests must still pass.

Add:
  pub struct Service;

  impl Service {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Service }

    pub fn divide(&self, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64
      — delegates to the package-level divide(a, b)

    pub fn get_value<'a>(&self, map: &'a std::collections::HashMap<String, i32>, key: &str) -> i32
      — delegates to the package-level get_value(map, key)

    pub fn parse_age(&self, s: &str) -> u32
      — delegates to the package-level parse_age(s)

    pub fn first_element(&self, v: &[i32]) -> i32
      — delegates to the package-level first_element(v)

    pub fn find_user<'a>(&self, users: &'a [&str], name: &str) -> usize
      — delegates to the package-level find_user(users, name)
  }

Also implement Default for Service.
Add tests for the Service struct methods.
Do not modify the existing functions or tests.
All 5 existing tests must still pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: Service unit struct with new() constructor
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `cargo test` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
